title: 函館スプリントSにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the first trial of her training—the Hakodate Sprint Stakes, and Curren Chan is as cute as ever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Believing she'll learn something during this race, she's eager for the race to begin!
